recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is for core FHIR. Future public test server endpoint corrections should be made on the Confluence Public Test Servers page rather than in source/implsupport-module.html.
issue_request: FHIR-11455 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 correction for the Implementation Support module. It said the server URLs on the September 2016 implementation support page were wrong and resolved to fix them after discussion with the server maintainers; Brian Postlethwaite later commented that he updated his test server address and that the UHN address might remain acceptable.

Later Published issue FHIR-31735 and commit e404ccd07129409bf907b904ae62ded6c82d28bf intentionally moved mutable implementation-support tool/server/library listings out of core source and into Confluence pages; FHIR-31735 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The original stale URL was fixed in the DSTU2/STU3-era page, and the current source avoids reintroducing mutable server URLs by linking to the Confluence-maintained public test server list.
